title: OT Connector Sample Envelope
description: A single read result published to te/device/<device>/ot/<protocol>/sample/<point>.

ts.description: Read completion time, RFC 3339, millisecond precision, UTC (Z).

ts_ms.description: Read completion time as Unix epoch milliseconds (float; the numeric companion to 'ts' for consumers doing time arithmetic).

value.description: Decoded value in typed mode. Absent in raw mode and when quality=bad.

value_repr.description: How a consumer should interpret 'value'. Required when 'value' is present.

raw.description: Hex of the bytes read, words space-separated in protocol-natural width.

type.description: The device's declared type (§3.1), when it has one. Lets consumers name the point's parameter set (§5.2) without the configuration file. Per device, not per point, and short — unlike the point's name/description, which are static per point and published once in the capability descriptor instead.

access.description: The point's declared access (default read). Lets consumers tell writable points (parameters) apart without the configuration file.

addr.description: Protocol-specific address echo. Shape defined by each connector spec.

seq.description: Monotonic per-point counter of published samples. Readings withheld by the reporting policy (§5.3) do not consume a number, so a gap means a published sample was lost.

error.description: Human-readable failure reason. Required when quality=bad.

meta.description: The point's free-form 'meta' table from the connector configuration, echoed verbatim by the runtime. Flows use it for per-signal behaviour (measurement naming, alarms, events, parameters); absent when the point declares no meta.

examples.error: modbus exception: gateway target device failed to respond
